label: Rear-window residential burglaries, Pico-Union, Los Angeles, 2023
area: Pico-Union, Los Angeles, CA (Rampart Division); suspected additional burglaries in the Hollenbeck area

linking_evidence: Rampart burglary detectives recognized five residential burglaries as a series on 2023-10-04
surveillance footage showed four masked suspects using the same pry method on rear windows and doors
footage showed the same getaway vehicle, a white SUV, leaving a second location

officers surveilled a possible vehicle, saw an additional vehicle that was an exact match, stopped it and detained three men whom LAPD says matched the earlier burglaries by tattoos, clothing and physical description
ground_truth.notes: The release does not itemize the five burglaries, so the five records are indistinguishable. Police believe the crew is responsible for about 30 residential burglaries in the Rampart and Hollenbeck areas; those are not itemized and have no folders. Five exterior and interior stills and one vehicle photo are in the series photos folder. Three of the stills carry burned-in camera timestamps of 2023-09-29 between about 11:36 and 11:39 AM, a Friday. The release does not say which burglary the stills belong to, so the timestamps are not attached to any incident. Series-wide loss is cash and jewelry, about 100,000 dollars. The majority of victims were of Asian descent per LAPD. The status of the fourth suspect is not reported.

outcome.summary: Three men arrested; the district attorney filed burglary charges on two of the three. Later outcome not reported.

data_policy: Public sources only. No suspect or victim names, ages, or exact addresses.
